title: Approach-taxonomy coverage ratchet baseline
description: The floor for monitor/test/approach-taxonomy-coverage.test.mjs. Two banks, both of which must be able to EMPTY: `undeclared` holds checks the fleet runs that monitor/approach-taxonomy.json does not describe, `orphans` holds approaches naming a check no manifest declares. Seeded from HEAD, never from a working tree — a floor seeded from a dirty tree bakes in another session's unlanded manifest and then describes a state no other checkout has.

declared.description: count of checks across the fleet manifests when seeded

described.description: count of approaches in the taxonomy when seeded

undeclared.description: check ids with no taxonomy entry. A NEW id here fails the ratchet; an id that gains an entry must be removed or the floor is stale.

orphans.description: taxonomy entries naming a check no manifest declares — usually a lane whose manifest change is unlanded. Banked rather than red, and must be removed once the check is declared.
